question: Should the bundled OpenAI provider officially support forwarding selected token/OAuth credentials to an operator-configured loopback Codex broker, and what broker trust boundary must be documented before it lands?
rationale: Exact loopback URL validation constrains destination reachability, but it cannot authenticate the local listener; accepting that credential recipient is a product and security-boundary decision rather than a mechanical patch choice.

options.title: Accept a constrained local-broker contract
options.body: Approve the loopback-only route after a rebased branch provides redacted live discovery and inference proof plus clear operator-facing trust, image, and usage limitations.

options.title: Keep credential forwarding outside core
options.body: Decline the new bundled-provider route and direct deployments to a separate provider or broker integration if OpenClaw should not recognize local brokers as credential recipients.

recommendation.title: Accept a constrained local-broker contract
recommendation.body: Approve the loopback-only route after a rebased branch provides redacted live discovery and inference proof plus clear operator-facing trust, image, and usage limitations.
